issues.description: Numbering continues from table D (1–9) on p.228. The second table (20–30) repeats the caption with different capitalisation; items 21–30 are “let”-sentences rather than strict imperatives. Retained: “Don't ever try to talk me”, “let me to be”, “a best solution”, “win a gold”.
